name: Lamborghini Murciélago LP 670-4 SV E-Gear
description: At the 2009 Geneva Motor Show, Lamborghini unveiled the Murciélago LP 670-4 SuperVeloce, the ultimate high-performance variant of the Murciélago lineup. The SV moniker, previously appearing on the legendary Miura and Diablo, denotes a more track-oriented variant produced in limited numbers. The LP 670-4 SV features a 6.5-liter V12 engine producing 670 hp, extensive use of carbon fiber reducing weight by 100 kg compared to the standard LP 640, and revised aerodynamics including a large fixed rear wing generating significant downforce. With all-wheel drive and the E-Gear automated manual transmission, the SV accelerates from 0-100 km/h in just 3.2 seconds and reaches a top speed of 342 km/h. Only 350 units were produced, making it one of the most sought-after modern Lamborghinis.
author: Binary Motors(Jerry Wei)
